scope: LLM serving and multimodal/agent requests; not a claim of exhaustive AI workload coverage

classification_proposals.boundary: Orthogonal to coding/science/business task type; do not count topology as a disjoint task family.
General constraints and replanning are not scientific-experiment planning.
Preserve query timestamps and permitted prefixes; offline whole-video inference is not equivalent.
Text input and generated audio output; not ASR or a text-only voice proxy.
Embedding output and retrieval/similarity protocol, not generated text.
Query-candidate relevance scoring; declare the candidate set and do not fabricate official negatives.
Use source-provided task and recorded/target length; do not force output to a chosen length.

sources.name: MultiAgentBench / MARBLE
sources.required_assets: Official per-scenario tasks/configuration, environment, coordination protocol and scorer.
sources.limit: Task definitions are not pre-existing production request/communication traces. Keep source scenario identities.

sources.name: Qwen DeepPlanning
sources.required_assets: Fixed task version, travel/shopping databases, sandbox, tools and official constraint evaluator.
sources.limit: Travel has Chinese/English tasks; shopping has English tasks. Keep per-language records and link equivalent tasks only with publisher evidence; count records, executions and parent tasks separately. Do not rewrite a tool-mediated task as one chat prompt.

sources.name: StreamingBench
sources.required_assets: Original videos, questions, timestamps and official prefix/protocol configuration.
sources.limit: A source-simulated streaming task does not itself establish measured real-time streaming latency.

sources.name: OVO-Bench
sources.required_assets: Fixed source video/chunks, task annotations, query timing and native evaluation.
sources.limit: Respect temporal visibility and task modes; no future frames or offline-to-live performance equivalence.

sources.name: Full-Duplex-Bench
sources.required_assets: Choose a fixed v1/v1.5/v2/v3 protocol, corresponding audio/metadata, client/server loop and scorer.
sources.limit: Version data and execution differ; publisher-constructed audio is labeled as such. Base-corpus rights require separate review.

sources.name: LibriTTS (SLR60)
sources.required_assets: One declared official split with transcripts, speaker identity and waveform references.
sources.license_hint: Publisher states CC BY 4.0; retain attribution and verify the selected assets.
sources.limit: Not a duplex dialogue corpus or an official universal TTS scorer.

sources.name: LJ Speech 1.1
sources.required_assets: Version 1.1 metadata and original waveform mapping.
sources.license_hint: Publisher declares public domain; confirm intended jurisdiction and selected files.
sources.limit: Single-speaker reading is not representative of all speech generation or conversational timing.

sources.name: SciFact, BEIR retrieval release
sources.required_assets: Distinguish BEIR release from original SciFact; pin corpus, queries, qrels and split.
sources.limit: BEIR is a collection/framework, not one dataset. Candidate retrieval protocol and corpus rights remain explicit.

sources.name: NFCorpus, BEIR retrieval release
sources.required_assets: Pinned corpus, queries, qrels and split with original data terms.
sources.license_hint: Original NFCorpus page permits academic use; other uses require consultation with its data owner.
sources.limit: Ranking a selected candidate set differs from full-corpus retrieval; record both protocols.

sources.name: MS MARCO passage ranking
sources.required_assets: Explicit passage-ranking version, queries, corpus, qrels and candidate protocol.
sources.license_hint: Publisher restricts use to non-commercial research; not a default enterprise redistribution asset.
sources.limit: Do not conflate original QA, passage ranking and document ranking releases.

sources.name: STS Benchmark, Sentence Transformers distribution
sources.required_assets: Pin distribution/revision, split, two texts and score scale; retain original lineage.
sources.limit: A similarity pair is not a production retrieval request or evidence of prefix reuse; MTEB remains the evaluation framework.

sources.name: DocVQA single-document release
sources.required_assets: Choose original single-document release; pin document images, QA annotations and access conditions.
sources.limit: Not the same asset as DocVQA2026; registration/download rights and image rights need explicit review.

sources.name: CodeJudge-Eval (COLING 2025)
sources.required_assets: Pinned released input/code and separate answer labels; retain original problem provenance and grouping.
sources.limit: Not the different VichyTong/CodeJudge framework. Do not invent judge prompts from existing code-generation questions.

sources.name: DRAGOn public news QA/text snapshots
sources.required_assets: Matching fixed public QA/text release tags and original version identity.
sources.limit: Monthly snapshots and publisher-generated questions are not per-document production update/delete events or query-version bindings. Private-named sources are not assumed accessible.

sources.name: TemporalWiki (EMNLP 2022)
sources.required_assets: Pinned released snapshot/diff/evaluation assets and their original licenses.
sources.limit: Designed for ever-evolving language models; use only its real temporal assets, not relabeling them as complete online RAG traces.

sources.name: GitHub Copilot Coding Agent Traces 2026
sources.required_assets: Pinned ghcp-coding-agent-2026 release shards, schema and attribution.
sources.limit: No prompts, source code or tool outputs; cannot replay original requests or derive exact KV block identity. Cancellation/attempt semantics must be checked from actual fields.

sources.name: Azure LMM Inference Traces 2025
sources.required_assets: Its own 2025 release/schema, separate from existing AZURE_LLM 2023 code/conv files.
sources.limit: Metadata is not image/video content or proof of a runnable visual task; inspect actual fields before assigning lifecycle coverage.

unresolved_evidence_gaps.missing: Document identities, update/delete sequence, query time and binding to the authoritative document version.
Explicit cancellation, timeout, parent attempt identity and ordering; do not infer from latency or a failed tool call.
Actual engine cache/block ownership, eviction, migration and recomputation events; task input alone cannot contain this evidence.

policy: Missing sources remain visible but never fall back to synthetic data. No raw public/private payloads are distributed in this catalog. Each usable source requires its own sample receipt.
